sentences.text: 3. It is submitted that during pendency of the criminal proceedings, both the parties have amicably settled their dispute out of the Court.
They moved an application dated 10.07.2024 along with the supporting affidavit before the court below to quash the criminal proceedings on the basis of compromise.
It is further submitted that the instant matter is arising out of matrimonial dispute and the divorce petition under Section 13-B of Hindu Marriage Act has already been decided finally.

It is further submitted that in changed scenario, no dispute remains between the parties and they have buried the hatchet and, at present, there is no grudge against each other,
therefore, to observe peace and tranquility between them, instant criminal proceedings may be decided on the basis of the compromise.
4. Learned counsel for the opposite party nos.2 & 3 has nodded the submissions as raised by the learned counsel for the applicants and contended that in the changed circumstances, wherein parties have entered into compromise, opposite party nos.2 and 3 are no longer inclined to pursue the criminal proceedings against the accused (present applicants).
Therefore, proceedings may be decided on the basis of the compromise.
5. Learned AGA has no objection in relegating the parties before the court below to get this compromise verified.

6. In this conspectus, as above, both the parties are hereby directed to appear before the court concerned on 05/06.12.2024 for verification of their compromise along with the original copy of the compromise application.

After receiving the said compromise, learned court concerned shall verify the same in presence of both the parties after recording their statements and submit compromise verification report before this Court within a period of one month from the date of appearance of the parties.

7. List this matter on 06.02.2025 before appropriate Court along with the compromise verification report submitted/sent by the Trial Court, if any.
8.

Until further order(s) of this Court, further proceedings arising out of Case Crime No.20 of 2021 shall remain stayed."
3. Pursuant thereto, there is a report of Incharge Civil Judge (J.D.)/F.T.C./C.A.W., Etah dated 18.12.2024 that the parties have themselves come up with the stand that the compromise stands verified, thus, this Court finds that there is no reason to proceed with the matter.
